caption: The drawing features a rectangular composition with a dotted background bordered by a red and black outline. In the upper portion, large, stylized text in shades of red and pink spells “GOD BLESS OUR” in an ornate script, and below it, the word “HOME” is written in block capital letters using the same red and pink hues. The center of the image displays a two-story house in shades of tan and gray, with blue details indicating windows and doors. The house has a smaller annex to the left and three red chimneys. To the left of the house, there is a structure that appears to be a fence and possibly a well. Two green trees, one on each side of the house, are drawn with vertical and oval green strokes representing foliage. The ground is colored with horizontal strokes of green, indicating grass, and there are gray areas which may represent walkways or shadows. The entire drawing has a uniform pattern of small black dots filling the background.
title: Embroidered Picture
